notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Rush-hour commuter trains in Tokyo and Osaka are famously packed (⟦{満員電車|まんいんでんしゃ}→満員電車：08350_manindensha⟧), and many lines run women-only cars (⟦{女性専用車両|じょせいせんようしゃりょう}→女性専用車両：08490_joseisenyousharyou⟧) in the morning rush.
